title: Repair Repo CLI MCP Transport and Native Metadata
description: Fix repo CLI and MCP server JSON transport corruption, native client inference, and current LLM validation so ticket tools work from Codex without invalid stdout or redundant metadata.
summary: Repaired repo CLI and MCP command routing to the actual Go package directories, restored Nx-backed local dev/build/test scripts, reserved stdout for JSON-RPC by routing operational warnings to stderr, inferred native MCP clients, accepted current gpt-5-5 and opus-4-7 model IDs, and normalized Windows command paths. Verified the CLI build, focused tests, uncached repo-MCP suite, and a live Codex ticket_reopen call with gpt-5-5 and no client.
